summary: Layer 1B expands the US-listed universe around the upstream CPO/silicon-photonics manufacturing stack. The strongest direct public-market fits found in this pass are Veeco for compound-semiconductor/MOCVD and related process tools, Coherent for vertically integrated InP photonics and optical connectivity, FormFactor for wafer-level silicon-photonics optical/electrical test, and Onto Innovation as a metrology/inspection and advanced-packaging process-control supplier. The list intentionally avoids filling with mega-cap switch ASIC or hyperscaler names; those remain demand anchors rather than the focus of this underfollowed supply-chain node.
